key: RADOMUS: Any moment now, the show shall begin.
en: RADOMUS: Any moment now, the show shall begin.
ja: ラドマス: まもなく、幕が上がる。

key: HARDY: Gigalith, return!
en: HARDY: Gigalith, return!
ja: ハーディ: ギガイアス、戻れ!

key: HARDY: It worked, yea?
en: HARDY: It worked, yea?
ja: ハーディ: うまくいったよな?

key: RADOMUS: It certainly didn't not work.
en: RADOMUS: It certainly didn't not work.
ja: ラドマス: 少なくとも、失敗ではなかったな。

key: At a glance, the damage should make that way traversable.
en: At a glance, the damage should make that way traversable.
ja: 一目見た限り、この損傷なら通れるようになったはずだ。

key: HARDY: But what about the others?!
en: HARDY: But what about the others?!
ja: ハーディ: でも他の奴らはどうなった?!

key: I couldn't see 'em!
en: I couldn't see 'em!
ja: 見えなかったんだ!

key: RADOMUS: Nor could I clearly.
en: RADOMUS: Nor could I clearly.
ja: ラドマス: 私もはっきりとは見えなかった。

key: I am sure Saphira and Aya were clear of the attack.
en: I am sure Saphira and Aya were clear of the attack.
ja: サファイラとアヤは攻撃の範囲外だったはずだ。

key: And I do believe I saw Sirius tail them immediately to its edge.
en: And I do believe I saw Sirius tail them immediately to its edge.
ja: シリウスがすぐに端まで彼女らを追っていくのも見えた気がする。

key: However, I could not say about Fern...
en: However, I could not say about Fern...
ja: だが、ファーンについては何とも言えん…

key: HARDY: So, Fern's probably...
en: HARDY: So, Fern's probably...
ja: ハーディ: じゃあ、ファーンはたぶん…
俺は――

key: This stuff's heavy...
en: This stuff's heavy...
ja: こいつは重いな…

key: RADOMUS: All the lead in the world is but a feather compared to the burden guilt weighs.
en: RADOMUS: All the lead in the world is but a feather compared to the burden guilt weighs.
ja: ラドマス: この世のすべての鉛も、罪悪感という重荷に比べれば羽根のようなものだ。

key: I would know.
en: I would know.
ja: 私にはよくわかる。

key: HARDY: I gotta... make sure Aya's okay.
en: HARDY: I gotta... make sure Aya's okay.
ja: ハーディ: 俺は…アヤの無事を確かめねえと。

key: There's no time for that. Let's go!
en: There's no time for that. Let's go!
ja: そんな暇はねえ。行くぞ!

key: RADOMUS: This plan was my idea, after all.
en: RADOMUS: This plan was my idea, after all.
ja: ラドマス: そもそも、この作戦は私の発案だ。

key: If anything, the weight of his life should lay on me.
en: If anything, the weight of his life should lay on me.
ja: むしろ、彼の命の重みは私が背負うべきものだろう。

key: I should have said that sooner.
en: I should have said that sooner.
ja: もっと早く言うべきだった。

key: RADOMUS: One more is nothing compared to what I've already cost.
en: RADOMUS: One more is nothing compared to what I've already cost.
ja: ラドマス: これまで払わせてきた代償に比べれば、もう一人増えたところで大したことではない。

key: FERN: Ahahaha!
en: FERN: Ahahaha!
ja: ファーン: あはははは!

key: FERN: Oh, man, it is just too much!
en: FERN: Oh, man, it is just too much!
ja: ファーン: ああもう、笑いが止まらない!

key: I mean, I set it up, but I didn't think it would work that easily!
en: I mean, I set it up, but I didn't think it would work that easily!
ja: いや、あたしが仕掛けたんだけど、こんな簡単に引っかかると思ってなかった!

key: But lo and behold, \PN actually trapped himself in!
en: But lo and behold, \PN actually trapped himself in!
ja: でも見てよ、\PNってば本当に自分からわなにはまっちゃった!

key: But lo and behold, \PN actually trapped herself in!
en: But lo and behold, \PN actually trapped herself in!
ja: でも見てよ、\PNってば本当に自分からわなにはまっちゃった!

key: But lo and behold, \PN actually trapped themselves in!
en: But lo and behold, \PN actually trapped themselves in!
ja: でも見てよ、\PNってば本当に自分からわなにはまっちゃった!

key: FERN: How dumb can you get?!
en: FERN: How dumb can you get?!
ja: ファーン: どこまで馬鹿なわけ?!

key: Well, who cares?
en: Well, who cares?
ja: まあ、どうでもいいけど。

key: It'll be over in a minute anyway.
en: It'll be over in a minute anyway.
ja: どうせすぐ終わるし。

key: You've got nowhere to run now, so I hope you're ready to dance for me!
en: You've got nowhere to run now, so I hope you're ready to dance for me!
ja: もう逃げ場はないんだから、あたしのために踊る覚悟はできてるよね!

key: ???: \PN, heads up!
en: ???: \PN, heads up!
ja: ???: \PN、危ない!

key: ???: \PN, I've got you!
en: ???: \PN, I've got you!
ja: ???: \PN、任せて!

key: TITANIA: You good?
en: TITANIA: You good?
ja: ティタニア: 大丈夫?

key: VICTORIA: Are you okay?
en: VICTORIA: Are you okay?
ja: ヴィクトリア: 平気?

key: TITANIA: That wasn't exactly the smooth ride I was hoping for, but...
en: TITANIA: That wasn't exactly the smooth ride I was hoping for, but...
ja: ティタニア: 期待してたほどスムーズな乗り心地じゃなかったけど…

key: It got you out of there in one piece.
en: It got you out of there in one piece.
ja: 無事にあそこから連れ出せたわ。

key: That's more than I can say for some others.
en: That's more than I can say for some others.
ja: 他の何人かに比べれば、それだけでも上出来ね。

key: TITANIA: Looks like the only way to go is forward.
en: TITANIA: Looks like the only way to go is forward.
ja: ティタニア: 進む道は前しかなさそうね。

key: Lick your wounds and let's get get a move on.
en: Lick your wounds and let's get get a move on.
ja: 傷をなめるのはそこそこにして、動きましょう。

key: They may not be able to see us down here, but we're not accomplishing anything either.
en: They may not be able to see us down here, but we're not accomplishing anything either.
ja: ここにいれば見つからないだろうけど、それじゃ何も成し遂げられない。

key: Sorry for the rocky ride-- I...
en: Sorry for the rocky ride-- I...
ja: 揺れる乗り物でごめんね――わたし…

key: Panicked?
en: Panicked?
ja: パニックになってた?

key: Anyway, I don't think they can see us from here, but...
en: Anyway, I don't think they can see us from here, but...
ja: とにかく、ここからじゃ見つからないと思うけど…

key: VICTORIA: I don't think we have a way up either.
en: VICTORIA: I don't think we have a way up either.
ja: ヴィクトリア: 上に行く道もなさそうね。

key: I guess we'll have to go further down?
en: I guess we'll have to go further down?
ja: もっと下に行くしかないのかな?

key: I don't want them to have any more time to get away, but... I guess there's no choice.
en: I don't want them to have any more time to get away, but... I guess there's no choice.
ja: これ以上逃げる時間を与えたくないけど…仕方ないか。

key: Let's go.
en: Let's go.
ja: 行こう。

key: Um... I won?
en: Um... I won?
ja: えっと…わたしが勝った?

key: Oh...
en: Oh...
ja: ああ…

key: I never thought I'd make it here...
en: I never thought I'd make it here...
ja: まさかここまで来られるとは思わなかった…

key: I guess I'm not so worthless after all.
en: I guess I'm not so worthless after all.
ja: 俺も、そこまで役立たずじゃなかったってことか。

key: Listen up! The most important thing isn't power, it isn't courage, and it isn't even having friends! The only thing that matters is that you can rely on ME.
en: Listen up! The most important thing isn't power, it isn't courage, and it isn't even having friends! The only thing that matters is that you can rely on ME.
ja: よく聞け! 一番大事なのは力じゃない、勇気でもない、友達がいることですらない! 大事なのはただ一つ、俺を頼れるってことだけだ。

key: An old area map is posted here...
en: An old area map is posted here...
ja: 古いエリアマップが貼られている…

key: ...But it doesn't seem to be accurate anymore.
en: ...But it doesn't seem to be accurate anymore.
ja: …でも、もう正確ではないようだ。
